items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: Madcat, the great harmonica player who I still play with and who played with two generations of Brubeck, he was in that band.

ctx.x: I’m glad you mentioned Darius because there’s this wonderful picture in the recent book about your father, A Life in Time and you three are standing behind your parents and it struck me, it looks, it’s the time of the era. It looks like Dave and Iola go to Haight Asbury. Because you all had really long hair and it just is so terrific to see that combination of the generations. And I’m not even sure what I’m trying to say except it’s a great pic.

Well it is funny, like because at that point Gerry Mulligan had really long hair and a beard and would wear bell bottoms and stuff and I think Maynard Ferguson. I mean I think there was a lot of establishment jazz guys, instead of fighting it just started going with the flow. Hey, and to your previous question, we were talking about Dan’s groups, I just wanted to say that when I was coming out of Interlochen I met all these young very good classical musicians that also loved rock & roll. And we had school bands…

And I very consciously knew that Dave was this really popular figure in jazz and I couldn’t compete in that world but I really wanted to have a really really creative rock & roll band. And the first thing we did was the group was called The New Heavenly Blue. We did a record on RCA. And then we did a record on Atlantic. And that evolved into a group called Sky King that we did a record on Columbia. And Madcat, the great harmonica player who I still play with and who played with two generations of Brubeck, he was…
